label: Number Counter Row
description: Multiple stats side by side with animated count-up numbers and glass dividers. count:'roll' spins each digit into place like an odometer -- use it when the brief asks for rolling / ticking digits.

count.label: count (default: the number counts up) | roll (odometer: each digit spins into place -- prices, metrics)

plate.label: Plate: a dark frosted panel behind the row -- use it when the row sits over live picture (a person on camera, footage) so the numbers read on any ground
